chunks: Hisham ibn Ibrahim complained to Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام about his illness and that no child was being born to him, so he instructed him to raise his voice with the adhan in his home.
He said: So I did that, and Allah removed my illness from me, and my children became many.

Muḥammad ibn Rāshid said: I was constantly afflicted with illness, and I was never free of it in myself and in a group of my servants and dependents, until there were times when I remained with no one to serve me. So when I heard that from Hisham, I acted upon it, and Allah removed the illnesses from me and my dependents, and praise belongs to Allah.

key_terms.بِالْأَذَانِ: with the adhan, the call to prayer

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the benefit of raising the adhan in one's home?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام instructed Hisham ibn Ibrahim to recite the adhan aloud in his home when he complained of illness and childlessness. Hisham reports recovery and increase in offspring, and Muḥammad ibn Rāshid says he experienced similar relief for himself and his household after doing the same.
